panels.title: Same teaching problem
lines: Writes w held fixed in settling

slides.footer: SD-24: penalize e before adding w; old write-site prior penalized e + w.
slides.notes: 9 forward + 9 reverse evaluations per 8-step inference; JAX autodiff. Compare efficacy, harm, cost.

slides.title: A correction testbed with distinct controls
slides.status: Three realizations × five dependent orders; endpoint depends on dataset
slides.footer: zsRE / CounterFact: 1,000 edits. MQuAKE: descriptive at 300. This reader study uses BP, not PC credit.
slides.notes: 50 locality prompts do not exhaust specificity. Five orders within a realization are dependent.

slides.title: Retention improves, with limits to specificity
slides.status: Completed triplet + 270-cell comparator snapshot; preliminary three-realization analysis
slides.footer: Mean paraphrase retention: zsRE .9603; CounterFact .6780; MQuAKE .7156 (300 edits).
slides.notes: CounterFact vs stable: inconclusive. zsRE near-miss passes: 86 / 92 / 87 out of 100.

slides.title: Why look past the mean?
slides.status: Measured empirical survival; tail family unestablished
slides.footer: P(delta NLL > x), including unchanged positions in the denominator; own-cap-off reference.
slides.notes: HT-13 is descriptive pooling over repeated positions/cells. ES99 = mean of worst 1%, not percentile.

slides.title: Similar small means can hide different consequences
slides.status: HT-13 corrected v1.1: 270 receipted cells; own-cap-off reference
slides.footer: zsRE learned / live C2: maximum 11.05 / 50.60 nats; ES99+ .260 / .321 nats.
slides.notes: Means .002486 / .003198 nats are not an equivalence result. S1 base-continuation effects excluded.

slides.title: The κ pilot measures a retention–tail trade-off
slides.status: Development evidence: preliminary hints; declared gain not established
slides.footer: κ arms reduce ES95 descriptively but miss the retention floor and declared tail-separation rule.
slides.notes: DEC-054: not coupled free energy, a coupled blanket, or a one-κ test. This is a loss-level pilot.

slides.title: Corrected PC-v0: efficacy, harm and cost
slides.status: Exposed historical S5; 3 realizations × 5 orders; result slots await completed sources
slides.footer: All differences: corrected eight-step SE-E minus SE-A. Readout uses 4,064 fixed positions per arm.
slides.notes: Supplemental defect-correction replication; old S5 primary scoring. No fresh confirmation or general PC claim.

slides.title: Does PC credit transfer to the fixed v5 reader?
slides.status: One exposed R1 realization per dataset; 300 edits; paired credit-rule intervention
slides.footer: Same BP base, trained reader, gates, memory capacity and stream; fresh memory for each arm.
slides.notes: Only delta acquisition credit changes. Reader training remains BP; active-inference policy choice is proposed.

slides.title: What should the agent do next?
slides.status: Proposed active-inference extension; no new pre-October-9 commitment
slides.footer: Learning from observed failures motivates an experiment on autonomous information seeking.
slides.notes: Coupled free energy, kappa-porous blankets and the one-kappa conjecture remain proposed.

slides.title: What we learned, what remains, what it took
slides.status: Three themes; measured, proposed and pending claims kept visible
slides.footer: 270-cell snapshot: 392.42 process-hours, not elapsed GPU hours. PC costs reported separately.
